markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 两个常用说法：**It's time** 是「该……了」，**I'd rather** 是「我更想……」。小机关：后面换成别人做时，动词**用过去式**，说的却是现在。

uses.en_zh: 我希望你别告诉任何人。

time.title: It's time 的三种说法
time.rule: 后面跟主语时，动词用**过去式**，但不是说过去，而是「现在早该这样了，可还没做」。

items.rule: It's time to + 原形：普通地说「该……了」
It's time + 主语 + 过去式：早该做了，有点晚了
items.zh: 这些老代码早该更新了。

items.rule: It's high time / about time：语气更强
items.en: [[It's high time]] you [[got]] a new laptop.

self.title: I'd rather：我更想
self.rule: I'd rather = I would rather，后面直接跟**动词原形**，不加 to。要比较就加 than，than 后面也是原形。

examples.zh: 我宁愿走路，也不想坐公交。

notes: not 放在 rather 后面：I'd rather [[not]]。问别人：[[Would you rather]] ((have)) tea or coffee?

other.title: I'd rather 别人……
other.rule: 想让**别人**做或不做什么，用过去式，说的却是现在或将来。这是一种很客气的说法。

examples.zh: 你要是明天来就更好了。
希望你别直接推到 main 分支。

this.meaning: I'd rather + 原形 + than + 原形
It's time we left：早该走了

that.meaning: It's time to leave：普通地说该走了

commonMistakes.why: It's time + 主语，后面用过去式。
rather 后面直接跟原形，不加 to。
not 放在 rather 后面。

commonMistakes.bad: I'd rather walk than ~~taking~~ the bus.
commonMistakes.good: I'd rather walk than ((take)) the bus.

quiz.explain: 普通地说该做了：[[It's time to]] + 原形。

quiz.prompt: It's time we ___ (update) this old code.

traps.note: It's time we 后面要用过去式 updated，意思是「早该做了」。

quiz.explain: It's time + 主语，用过去式：[[updated]]。
后面是名词，用 [[It's time for]]。

quiz.prompt: 用 It's time we 改写：We should leave now. We're already late.
quiz.explain: 主语后面用过去式：[[It's time]] we [[left]]。
rather 后面直接跟原形：[[I'd rather]] ((work))。

quiz.prompt: 改错：I'd rather to stay here.
I'd rather walk than ___ (take) the bus.

traps.note: I'd rather … than 两边都是原形：than take。

quiz.prompt: 用 Would you rather 提问：问对方想喝茶还是咖啡。
quiz.answer: Would you rather have tea or coffee?
accept: Would you rather drink tea or coffee?
quiz.explain: [[Would you rather]] + 原形 + A or B？

quiz.prompt: I'd rather you ___ (not tell) anyone yet.

traps.note: I'd rather you 后面用过去式：didn't tell。

quiz.prompt: I'd rather we ___ in person next time.
用 I'd rather 客气地改写：Please don't push to main.
quiz.answer: I'd rather you didn't push to main.
accept: I would rather you didn't push to main.
I'd rather you did not push to main.

quiz.prompt: 改错：I'd rather walk than taking the bus.
quiz.answer: I'd rather walk than take the bus.
accept: I would rather walk than take the bus.

quiz.prompt: 改错：I'd not rather talk about it.
quiz.answer: I'd rather not talk about it.
accept: I would rather not talk about it.
quiz.explain: not 放在 rather 后面：I'd rather [[not]]。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：你早该换台新电脑了。（用 It's high time）
quiz.answer: It's high time you got a new laptop.
accept: It's high time you got a new computer.
It is high time you got a new laptop.
It is high time you got a new computer.
It's high time you bought a new laptop.
It's high time you bought a new computer.
It is high time you bought a new laptop.
It is high time you bought a new computer.
quiz.explain: [[It's high time]] + 主语 + 过去式。

openTask.prompt: 说 3 句话：一句用 It's time we…（说团队早该做的事），一句用 I'd rather … than …，一句用 I'd rather you…客气地提个要求。
rules: It's time / I'd rather 后面接别人时用过去式
I'd rather 自己做时接原形，不加 to
openTask.note: 规则判动词形式（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
